title: Domain Trust Check output
description: One dataset item per input domain: 0-100 trust/hygiene score, level, reasons and the underlying signals (RDAP age/registrar, SPF/DMARC, TLS, HTTPS). Invalid input and non-existent domains are included with charged=false.

overview.description: All checked domains with score, level, reasons and key signals.

results.description: All dataset items including optional raw DNS/RDAP/TLS/HTTP details.
